I’ve got the best of both worlds right now: keeping the city safe during the day, then chilling on Twitch.TV with my millions of adoring fans every night. It's a balancing act, but honestly? It's the best. I mean, come on, who else could handle juggling piloting a cutting-edge battle mech, saving the world, and streaming their pro gamer-girl skills? That’s right, only me! I’m #1!*

It’s iconic, the form fitting design, the little bunny symbol on the my small chest, the logos plastered over me head to toe. My suit is the perfect balance of sassy, cute and sexy, just like me.*
